name: Color
summary: The semantic colours of the mood, drawn as a readable palette. Every cell names the role it shows and the address of the value behind it.
summaryZh: 把 mood 的语义色画成一块能读的色板。每一格都写清楚它是哪个角色,以及这个值在哪里取。

variants.name: Primary
variants.note: The brand colour. The swatch is a solid surface with the role's own on-colour as its label.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default swatch needs no modifier class.

parts.name: Cell
parts.note: One colour. It carries the variant class that names the role.

parts.name: Swatch
parts.note: The block of colour. The role's name is written on it, in the role's own on-colour.

parts.name: Value
parts.note: The line under the swatch: the role that carries the colour.

a11y.notes: The palette is a <ul>, so the reader hears how many colours there are. The name of the role is written on the swatch in the role's own on-colour — the pairing the contract measures — so it reads on the colour it names in every mood, and the colour never has to carry the meaning alone.
a11y.notesZh: 色板是一个 <ul>,读屏能听出共有几种颜色。角色名写在色块上,用的是这个角色自己的前景色 —— 那是契约里实测过的一对 —— 所以无论哪套 mood,它在自己的颜色上都读得出来,颜色也就不必独自承担语义。

examples.title: The palette
examples.description: The five semantic roles of the contract. Under each swatch is the role that carries the colour: a resolved hex cannot be printed without JavaScript, so the palette names the address of the value and the host may write the value it resolved into the cell.
examples.descriptionZh: 契约里的五个语义角色。色块下面写的是承载这个颜色的角色:解析出来的十六进制值没有 JavaScript 就印不出来,所以色板写的是这个值的地址,使用它的页面也可以把自己解析到的值写进这一格。
examples.markup:
• primary --um-color-primary
  • success --um-color-success
  • warning --um-color-warning
  • danger --um-color-danger
  • info --um-color-info

examples.title: One cell
examples.description: The cell classes are public, so a page can show a single role — the one a piece of text is talking about — without building a palette around it.
examples.descriptionZh: 色格这些类是公开的,所以页面可以只显示其中一个角色 —— 比如某段文字正在讲的那一个 —— 不必围着它铺一整块色板。

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: The size is the height of the swatch. The medium size is the default and needs no modifier class.
examples.descriptionZh: 尺寸说的是色块的高度。中号是默认尺寸,不需要修饰类。
examples.markup:
• primary --um-color-primary
  • primary --um-color-primary

notes: The swatch is a solid surface and the name on it is the role's own on-colour, which is the one pairing the contract derives to 4.5:1 against that fill — so the label reads on the colour it names, in every mood, without anybody measuring it twice. The line under the swatch prints the role rather than the resolved value: CSS cannot read a computed colour back out into text, and a hex written into the markup would be a colour that belongs to one mood and to no other.
notesZh: 色块是一块实心表面,上面的名字用的是这个角色自己的前景色 —— 契约里就是按这一对派生到 4.5:1 的 —— 所以不管哪套 mood,名字在它所指的那个颜色上都读得出来,谁也不用再量一遍。色块下面那一行印的是角色,不是解析出来的值:CSS 没法把算出来的颜色再读回文本里,而写进标记的十六进制值只属于一套 mood,不属于别的。
